verdict.rationale: Semgrep supports exporting findings in open, standard formats such as SARIF (semgrep ci --sarif) and can generate SBOMs for supply-chain data, plus a documented API to pull findings/projects out of the AppSec Platform, and core scanning runs locally with local rule files (YAML) that are fully portable. However there is no explicit documentation of a full account/data export or account-deletion workflow covering all platform data (e.g., historical dashboards, triage state, integrations config), so 'leave with all your data' isn't fully evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented complete-data-export/account-portability feature covering all AppSec Platform data, not just findings/SBOM, and confirmation of full data deletion/exit process.
